With today's new version release, users who rely on the SmartGym iPhone app will find it easier to adjust and log workout sets during their training. Here's what's new.

SmartGym makes it easier for you to adjust and log your workout sets during training

SmartGym's Apple Watch app has long allowed users to quickly adjust reps and weights when logging each set of training.

With today's update, this flexibility has finally arrived on the iPhone app. Users can now freely switch between the existing logging interface and the new "Inline Logging" interface, which lets you adjust values, log sets, and add new sets without leaving the same screen.

The new interface also adds a small tag to the bottom-right corner of the reps and weight fields, showing the originally planned value for each set.

After logging a set, SmartGym will also start the rest timer directly on the same screen, allowing users to continue their workout without switching screens.

Here's what SmartGym says about itself:

This matters because SmartGym isn't just about logging what you did—it's about helping you understand what you were originally supposed to do.

This update also introduces a brand-new keyboard redesigned from scratch, making the in-workout logging process even smoother. The keyboard features buttons for quickly adjusting values, or switching training types between working sets, warm-up sets, and drop sets.

As SmartGym puts it: "Every second we save in the app is every second we give back to you for what matters more—your training."

Finally, today's update includes a redesigned Smart Action Button that can predict the user's most likely next action, and display the corresponding action option at the bottom of the interface based on what stage of the workout the user is in.

Options include "Log set and start rest", "Start exercise", "First superset", "Update set", "Next exercise", and "End workout", among others.

SmartGym says they have also improved the intelligence behind the Smart Action Button:

The end result is a feature that feels more natural. SmartGym quietly handles complex operations in the background, while users simply see exactly what they need, exactly when they need it.

One last point: users can set the iPhone's physical Action Button to trigger SmartGym's Smart Action Button, allowing you to manage your workout even faster without needing to operate the app.

SmartGym is available for free download on the App Store, with a variety of subscription plans offered.
